integrity: Exact finite-rate covariance formula derived analytically; standalone rational-arithmetic program tests selected graphs but is not a proof of arbitrary dimension. Literature-wide independent priority and independent audit have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-dimensional linearized harmonic oscillator model only; no nonlinear phase coherence, nonlinear stability, thermodynamic limit, or non-Poisson clock extension. The finite-dimensional cubic coefficient may cancel and is not a universal positive lower bound.
title: Cubic fluctuation shielding and clock-group interference in partially reset oscillator networks
